_what_this_is: GOLDEN preferences.json for the azure-iac-terraform corpus, with clarify-answers.json as the user. It is a BLOCKED Clarify: baseline.azure_monthly_spend is ESSENTIAL and unanswered, so the phase must emit GATE_FAIL. That is deliberate — it pins the completion gate rather than only the happy path.

availability.context: The source PostgreSQL flexible server is zone-redundant (high_availability.mode ZoneRedundant). Choosing single-az is a deliberate downgrade and Design will surface it as a finding; multi-az-ha would select Aurora instead of RDS.

cosmos_rw_split.reason: the only Cosmos account is Mongo API (kind MongoDB / EnableMongo), a fast-path row to DocumentDB. No RU/s conversion happens, so there is nothing to split.

azure_monthly_spend.reason: the user declined to state it, and no billing export was discovered, so there is nothing to detect it from. The migrate-versus-stay comparison is absent from the report.

licensing._firing_reason: one Windows VM (azurerm_windows_virtual_machine.reporting, image_publisher MicrosoftWindowsServer). No Microsoft.Sql/* resource is present, which is why sql_model is N/A while the category still fires.

ahub_in_use.source: no Azure Hybrid Benefit signal in the inventory. Recorded because AHUB does NOT travel: if it were in use, the customer pays a reduced Azure rate with no AWS equivalent, so the honest comparison is against the UNREDUCED rate. Comparing against the discounted rate makes AWS look worse than it is.
